acceptance_matrix.observable_result: One optional controller exclusively owns Responses and Batch operations, model/effort routing, credential resolution, exact configured-secret rejection, store:false, strict schemas, conservative cost estimation, admission, idempotency, retries, caching, external content addressing, provenance, validation, reporting, remote-file cleanup, and local temporary cleanup. No forecast-critical package imports this optional plane.

The local reservation/settlement ledger enforces the exact USD 100 envelope, allocation caps, $25/$50/$75/$90 threshold events, the $90 low-priority stop, restricted contingency release reasons, and an absolute committed-cost hard stop. Doctor and usage both report settled USD 0.00, reserved USD 0.00, and remaining USD 100.00.

The authoritative key was verified nonempty without displaying or copying it. Operational storage is external at <external-data-root>/openai with the required subdirectories. The strict secret scan passed; no .env, credential value, raw response, source excerpt, embedding, provider usage payload, or bulk API artifact entered Git.

Twelve focused tests cover strict schema closure, evidence rejection, key/header/env and exact-configured-secret rejection, budget settlement/hard stop, store:false, Responses Batch payloads, candidate-only caching, repository-relative Batch schema durability, failed-submission reservation release and remote-file deletion, and the representative local evaluation corpus. The final full suite passed 303 tests with two Windows privilege-dependent symlink skips.
